title: Tidy or Treat
description: Do you like to Act, Sing, Dance & Laugh? Play Action! Video Charades with Friends!Join the first LOL Video Charades game of 2013! Pick a Word. Act it out in front of your phone's camera. Challenge friends to watch your video and guess the word. You can talk, act, sing & dance. Share your video on the Wall of Fame and let everyone play your game. If you don't want to act, just watch, guess and laugh!? Featuring 100 LOL videos ready for you to guess? Popular videos played over 5000 times? Featured in What's Hot at the App Store in 100 countries? #3 Word Game in China in Jan. 2013? Top 100 app in 100 countries_________________________________ PRAISE FOR ACTION! “? ? ? ? ? It's SO much fun to see my friends trying to act on video!” - Mary Anne “? ? ? ? ? Love playing with my sister and seeing her face!" - Tammy "? ? ? ? ? Awesome! More fun than playing with farm animals!" - Brian R ADDICTIVE FEATURES ? Star in Your Own Video! Pick a word from popular movies, TV and music. Act it out on video for 10 seconds. ? Play with Friends on iPhone, iPad and iPod Touch! Challenge your friends to watch your video and guess the word. ? Turn-based Gameplay Perfect for gamers-on-the-go! Take turns acting and guessing at your own pace. ? Private Games Play one-on-one with friends and family. Keep your videos private. ? Wall of Fame Share your video on the Wall of Fame and and let everyone play your game! The Wall of Fame shows Featured, Newest, Top 10 & Popular videos. Enjoy your 10 seconds of fame. See how talented you are. Be discovered! ? New Words Every Week Enjoy fresh words every week with fun and timely themes. ? Pop Rockets Stumped by a difficult word or bad acting?
